national_news.title: 18th BRICS Summit Begins in New Delhi Under India's Chairship
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit commenced at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi under India's 2026 BRICS Chairship.
The theme for the summit is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', focusing on Global South aspirations and sustainable development.
The event brings together 11 member economies: India, Brazil, Russia, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.

national_news.title: PM Modi Urges BRICS Nations to Ensure Secure Sea Lanes and Reduce Trade Barriers
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the BRICS Business Forum in New Delhi, advocating for freedom of navigation, secure sea lanes, and seafarer safety to sustain global maritime trade.
Highlighted BRICS multilateral mechanisms including the BRICS Incubator Network, BRICS MSME Portal, and the BRICS Startup Innovation Fund.
Stated that BRICS now represents 50% of global population, 40% of global GDP, and over 25% of global trade, growing at nearly twice the pace of the global economy over 20 years.

national_news.title: Saudi Arabia Shuts East-West Pipeline Following Drone Strike
bullets: Saudi Arabia temporarily shut down its 1,200-km East-West oil pipeline as a precautionary measure following a drone attack originating from Iraq.
The East-West pipeline transports 4 to 5 million barrels per day (4-5% of global oil supply), serving as a crucial bypass route to the vulnerable Strait of Hormuz.
Concurrently, Houthi forces seized Mokha port and Perim Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, escalating geopolitical tensions along key global shipping choke points.

national_news.title: PM Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Putin, Pezeshkian, and UN Chief in New Delhi
bullets: PM Narendra Modi held bilateral meetings with Russian President Vladimir Putin, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, and UN Secretary-General António Guterres on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit.
PM Modi gifted President Putin a Russian translation of the ancient Tamil classic 'Thirukkural', published by the Central Institute of Classical Tamil.
President Putin formally invited PM Modi to Russia for the upcoming 24th India-Russia Annual Summit.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses BRICS Business Forum Session in New Delhi
bullets: Addressing the Leaders' Session of the BRICS Business Forum at Bharat Mandapam, PM Modi noted that BRICS accounts for 50% of world population, 40% of GDP, and over 25% of global trade.
Highlighted that the combined GDP of BRICS nations has expanded nearly four-and-a-half-fold, growing at twice the pace of the rest of the world.
Promoted the slogan 'Make in India, Innovate with India and Scale for the world' while advocating for freedom of navigation and secure supply routes.

national_news.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman Addresses Global Fintech Festival 2026
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed the Global Fintech Festival 2026, stressing technological innovation alongside safety, transparency, and human oversight.
Described Artificial Intelligence as a double-edged sword capable of detecting fraud but also automating larger frauds, calling for greater institutional accountability.
Urged the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to advance its wholesale and retail Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) pilot programs amid growing momentum in digital finance.

national_news.title: India Beats Bangladesh by 40 Runs to Reach Women's Asia Cup 2026 Final
bullets: India defeated Bangladesh by 40 runs in the first semi-final of the Women's Asia Cup 2026 at Dubai.
Player of the Match Shafali Verma top-scored with 64 runs off 40 balls, setting a target of 150 runs.
Deepti Sharma took three wickets as India restricted Bangladesh to 109/7 in 20 overs.

national_news.title: IPC Hosts National Conference on Biosimilars under Biopharma SHAKTI Vision
bullets: The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, organized a national conference in Bengaluru.
The event released the Indian Pharmacopoeia Reference Substance (IPRS) for Enoxaparin Sodium for bioassays to standardize biological activity testing.
The initiative aligns with India's 'Biopharma SHAKTI Vision' to strengthen indigenous pharmaceutical quality infrastructure and global competitiveness.

national_news.title: PM Shri JNV Ukhrul-1 Manipur Wins 27th National Youth Parliament Competition
bullets: Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Kiren Rijiju felicitated the winners of the 27th National Youth Parliament Competition (2025-26) organized for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas.
PM Shri Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Ukhrul-1, Manipur (Shillong Region) secured the national top spot and received the Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru Running Parliamentary Shield.
The competition was conducted across 100 Vidyalayas in eight regions of the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti to build parliamentary awareness, debate, and leadership skills among students.

national_news.title: Rubber Cultivation Expands to 33,000 Hectares in Meghalaya with RRII Assistance
bullets: Rubber cultivation in Meghalaya expanded from 10,000 hectares over a decade ago to approximately 33,000 hectares, supported by the Rubber Research Institute of India (RRII), Kottayam.
The Rubber Board provides technical support through its Tura Regional Office and eight field stations, focusing heavily on the Garo Hills region.
Group Processing Centres (GPCs) were set up under Green Hill RPS and Laurel Hills RPS in Mendipathar to facilitate local latex processing into rubber sheets for higher value addition.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Conduct Month-Long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' State-Wide Campaign
bullets: Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting for the state-wide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan', scheduled to run from September 17 to October 17.

The campaign comprises 13 key initiatives, including 'Aashirwad ka Diya', school-based 'Seva Chitra' activities, 'Aangan ka Milan' to honor Anganwadi and ASHA workers, and rallies under 'Seva Jyoti Yatra' with Mera Yuva Bharat volunteers.

Under the 'Seva Mera Yogdan' initiative, 25 community activities—including Chhath ghat cleaning, tree plantation, and sanitation drives—will be implemented at a minimum of two locations per assembly constituency.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Transfers ₹1,233 Crore under Social Security Pension Scheme via DBT
bullets: The Bihar government transferred ₹1,233.87 crore directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank accounts of over 1.05 crore social security pensioners.
Under the scheme, beneficiaries including senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities receive ₹1,100 per month, with 98,896 new beneficiaries added.

The state announced that social security pensions will be transferred on the 10th of every month, alongside laying the foundation stone for widening National Highway 333 from Gangta (Munger) to Kodwarva (Jamui).

bihar_news.title: NFHS-6 Highlights Divergent Demographic Trends Across Indian States
bullets: According to the 6th National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) stands at 2.0 children per woman, dropping below the replacement level of 2.1.
Out of 36 states and UTs, 34 are now at or below replacement fertility, leaving only Bihar and Meghalaya above the replacement threshold.

Projections show that by 2051, Uttar Pradesh (132 million) and Bihar (111 million) will drive the majority of India's net working-age population growth as workforce growth flattens in southern states.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 25 New Sugar Mills Under Sugarcane Investment Policy 2026
bullets: The Bihar government unveiled the Sugarcane Investment Policy 2026 during a two-day investors' conference in New Delhi on September 9-10, 2026.
The state targets the establishment of 25 new sugar mills and value-added industries focused on ethanol, power generation, and bio-energy.
Union Secretary Santosh Kumar Sarangi inaugurated the event, which aims to boost private investment and agricultural employment in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: BREDA Initiates Tender for 500 MW Rooftop Solar on Government Buildings Under RESCO Model
bullets: The Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA) floated a tender to empanel solar developers for 500 MW of grid-connected rooftop solar projects.
Projects will be executed under the Renewable Energy Service Company (RESCO) model on government buildings across Bihar.
The RESCO structure enables solar deployment without upfront capital expenditure or operational responsibilities for building owners.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Sattu and Makhana Featured in Special Goodie Bags at BRICS Summit 2026
bullets: Special goodie bags curated for international delegates and journalists at the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi prominently featured Bihar's traditional Sattu and Makhana.
The summit is scheduled for September 12-13, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, bringing together representatives from BRICS member and partner nations.
The hampers also showcased regional products like Odisha's Arabica coffee and Gujarat's block-printed stoles to promote Indian culture and cuisine.
